Thermaltake TR2 600W Bronze  Thermaltake new TR2 Series is power supply units (PSU) that incorporate various high-quality components, ranging from 450W to 600W that will always accommodate any mainstream build under any circumstance. Embedded intelligent cooling fan delivers silent cooling with intelligent temperature control. Single +12V rail design enable non-stop usage with stable and reliable performance. Ultra Quiet Fan Large 120mm cooling fan with intelligent RPM control delivers cool performance and silent operation. Elongated Cables The longer cables enable enthusiasts and power users to properly route the cables in optimal location to prevent airflow blockage. Significantly improving computer system’s overall thermal efficiency, as well as the aesthetic. 80 PLUS Bronze Certified and Kaby Lake-Ready TR2 Bronze Series saves energy through its high energy efficiency of up to 85% and is 80 PLUS® Bronze certified. Additionally, TR2 Bronze Series has been optimized to work with Intel’s new, Seventh-generation Kaby Lake processors to achieve maximum energy savings. High Quality Japanese Main Capacitor High-quality Japanese capacitor produces supreme stability and performance with low impedance characteristics. This delivers stable operation over extended periods of time, as well as excellent reliability. Massive and Dedicated Single +12V Output TR2 Series is equipped with a powerful +12V rail, superior performance under all types of system loading.
